insecureHttp.title: HTTP is not safe.
insecureHttp.body: This Teletype session is not encrypted. People between your browser and host can read or change traffic.
setup.subtitle: Remote server console
setup.instruction: Run this command in your Minecraft server console to authenticate:
setup.errorChallengeExpired: Verification challenge expired or was already used. Refresh to create a new challenge.
setup.errorTooManyRequestsPolling: Too many auth requests. Waiting before trying again.
setup.errorTooManyRequestsInitial: Too many auth requests. Wait a moment and refresh.
setup.errorRequestFailed: Authentication request failed ({{status}}). Refresh and try again.
setup.errorUnreachable: Cannot reach Teletype server. Is the plugin running?
setup.hint: Other server-side controls (status, restart the panel, log everyone out) are listed by /tty help.
